body: The previous PR #767 would require a minor (breaking) release because it removed the toml-based constructors for 1M options ( e.g. `CloudLiquidFormation(::CP.ParamDict)`). This PR adds the constructors back in with deprecations.
title: Add deprecations to avoid breaking interface

body:
PR https://github.com/CliMA/CloudMicrophysics.jl/pull/767 changes interface with ClimaAtmos. Preparing to make a breaking release.

title: Bumping the version for a breaking release
